author: worker
summary: Close the MOVEMENT D2 finding ('runtime uses DOM shim, not real browser') with a new contract RUNTIME.REAL_BROWSER.BOOT_AND_TICK, the living probe tools/verification/verify_runtime_real_browser.mjs, and killed real-source mutation MUT-RUNTIME-003. No protected-manifest entry exists for this surface; none was edited.
motivation: The retired Jest suites instantiated the simulation under jsdom, and evidence/seed-runtime-verification.mjs recorded that the runtime was never proven in a real browser. The probe now builds the current source with Vite, serves it on loopback, drives a real headless Chrome over CDP with SwiftShader software GL pinned (deterministic renderer stack; see the probe scope note), and asserts at DOM level that the runtime boots a populated simulation (pop > 0) and that its counters keep advancing within a bounded observation window (up to 30s; the frame loop reschedules). 11/11 assertions pass on Chrome/155 (STABLE across two suite repetitions). Removing the loop's requestAnimationFrame reschedule kills the probe via the advancement assertion only: the frozen one-frame mutant still passes 10/11 assertions, including pop > 0, which is why the kill rests on advancement rather than on boot.

registryAdditions.statement: THE BROWSER RUNTIME MUST KEEP ITS FRAME LOOP ALIVE: THE BUILT APP, LOADED IN A REAL BROWSER, MUST BOOT A POPULATED SIMULATION AND ITS DOM COUNTERS MUST KEEP ADVANCING ACROSS OBSERVATION WINDOWS, NOT FREEZE AFTER A SINGLE FRAME.
registryAdditions.livingBinding: tools/verification/verify_runtime_real_browser.mjs > the simulation advanced within a 30s window (not one frozen frame)

contractAdditions.note: New 12th contract; worker-authored and awaiting independent review.

workerDiscipline.note: The worker did not modify the protected manifest or docs/guardian/ACCEPTED_STATE.json; this proposal awaits guardian acceptance. docs/contracts/CONTRACT_ID_REGISTRY.json is worker-authored bootstrap (frozenBy PENDING_SUPERVISOR, V6 section 2) and gains an honest MUT-RUNTIME-003 binding.

requestedDecision: Accept RUNTIME.REAL_BROWSER.BOOT_AND_TICK as a valid contract candidate with a living probe, and record MUT-RUNTIME-003 among the post-V8 development additions (registry denominator note updated 14 to 15). Optionally require the probe in CI (FEAR_AI_BROWSER_REQUIRED=1) where a Chrome binary is guaranteed.
